pages.text: A green bell had hung around Kiki's neck. Playing in the snow, Kiki lost it.
Kiki wanted it back, but was sulky after an earlier quarrel with Gugu.
Alone, Kiki dug through snow until their hands turned red.
Gugu asked, "What are you looking for?" Kiki slipped under the wall and crouched. "I will not tell you."
Nono and Gugu went elsewhere. Kiki dug alone beneath the wall.
The sun set. The snow grew dim.
Kiki had not found the bell. Their neck felt empty.
Holding a lamp, Grandpa Badger pointed toward Nono and Gugu.
Kiki called them. "I lost my bell. Please help me find it."
All three searched the snow under the lamplight. Gugu picked up the green bell.
